es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id), common AS (SELECT s2024.student_id, s2024.course_id, s2024.total_score AS total_2024, s2025.total_score AS total_2025 FROM s2024 JOIN s2025 ON s2024.student_id=s2025.student_id AND s2024.course_id=s2025.course_id), agg AS (SELECT student_id, SUM(total_2024) AS sum_2024, SUM(total_2025) AS sum_2025 FROM common GROUP BY
